function.description: Take a message when nobody can pick up, when the caller prefers a callback, or when a tool has failed twice. Capture name, callback number, and a one-line subject; promise the manager will call back as soon as possible. Never write health or medical detail into any field — say 'a health matter'.
function.name: takeMessage

body.description: Any extra detail the caller gave. Again: no health or medical detail, ever.

callbackNumber.description: Number to call back, ONLY as the caller spoke it aloud or as it arrived on caller ID. A web call has NO caller ID, so on one you must ask. Never invent a number — a made-up one sends staff to call a stranger.

callbackNumberConfirmed.description: Set true ONLY after reading the number back digit by digit and hearing the caller confirm it. If you did not read it back, set false.

subject.description: One short line: what it is about. NEVER include health or medical detail.
